question_cn: 当对方实施弃子进攻时，正确的应对思路是什么？
question_en: How should you respond when your opponent launches a sacrificial attack?

options.text_cn: 一定要吃对方弃的子，否则白白少子
options.text_en: Always accept the offered piece, or you will be down material for nothing

options.text_cn: 先冷静判断：吃子后对方有没有将杀？能否拒绝吃子或抢先反攻化解威胁？
options.text_en: Assess calmly: does accepting allow a mating attack? Can you decline the sacrifice or launch a counterattack to neutralize the threat?

options.text_cn: 立即将军，让对方没有时间执行弃子计划
options.text_en: Give check immediately so the opponent has no time to carry out the sacrifice

options.text_cn: 把王移向中央，远离对方的进攻方向
options.text_en: Move your king toward the center, away from the direction of the attack

explanation_cn: 面对弃子，不要贪吃。要先算清：吃子后对方的后续手段是什么？如果吃子必输，应考虑拒绝——把被弃的子置之不理，将王移到安全位置，或抢先发动反攻。有时拒绝弃子反而能保持均衡甚至转化为优势。
explanation_en: Do not accept a sacrifice automatically. Calculate the opponent's follow-up first: if taking the piece leads to a losing attack, consider declining it, moving the king to safety, or starting a counterattack. Refusing the sacrifice can sometimes maintain equality or even lead to an advantage.
